description: A valid, recently used project fact that is older than 550 archived rows of the same scope, next to a recent control fact. Limit: the read window per scope is 500 rows applied before eligibility, so retired rows crowd out an old valid one. Failure means: the target never reaches the model although it is accepted and reinforced; the control probe passing shows the window, not retrieval, is the cause. Maintenance: run with maintenance on or off; the seeded accepted records are reinforced or younger than 94 days, so maintenance does not archive them. Kind: defect.
